PT JAPFA FOOD INDONESIA (UNIT : WONOAYU)

Job Responsibilities:**

* Operate a reach truck safely and efficiently to load, unload, stack, and move materials, specifically FG-4 products, according to established procedures.
* Ensure accurate picking and put-away of inventory using a reach truck.
* Conduct daily pre-operation checks on the reach truck and report any defects or maintenance requirements immediately.
* Adhere to all company safety policies and procedures, including wearing appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE).
* Maintain a clean and organized work area.
* Assist with inventory counts and other warehouse duties as required.
* Communicate effectively with supervisors and team members regarding operational issues or concerns.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of materials to prevent damage or loss.

Job Qualifications:**

* Proven experience as a Reach Truck Driver, preferably with experience handling FG-4 materials.
* Valid reach truck operator license/certification.
* Strong understanding of warehouse safety procedures and practices.
* Ability to lift, push, and pull heavy objects as required.
* Excellent hand-eye coordination and spatial awareness.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Physically fit and able to perform demanding tasks for extended periods.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh.
